description:
Log in to Canvas as admin (canvas@example.edu / canvas-docker). Go to the Calendar and create two events for the 'CHEM101' course. 

1. Event 'Final Exam Review Session': Schedule it 7 to 14 days from today from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM. Location/Description must include 'Science Building Room 204'. Description must include 'comprehensive review' and 'practice problems'.

2. Event 'Drop-in Office Hours - Final Prep': Schedule it exactly ONE DAY BEFORE the review session, from 2:00 PM to 3:00 PM. Location/Description must include 'Faculty Office 312'. Description must include 'one-on-one' and 'last chance'.

Ensure both events are associated with the CHEM101 course calendar, not your personal calendar.
